491ebabe-85f5-4337-8315-20a60785db8d.text: TLDR: 8 essential B vitamins in one tablet with DUAL-ACTION release — half dissolves instantly for immediate energy, half releases over 8 hours for sustained metabolism support. Water-soluble means your body uses what it needs and excretes the rest. Zero risk of overdose.
Why B Vitamins Matter

B vitamins are coenzymes — they're required for every step of converting food into cellular energy (ATP). Without adequate B vitamins, your metabolism literally slows down. This is why B deficiency manifests as fatigue, brain fog, slow metabolism, and poor skin.

B vitamins are water-soluble and depleted daily by: stress (B5, B6), alcohol (B1, B12), poor diet, medications (metformin depletes B12), and simply being alive. Unlike fat-soluble vitamins, you cannot store large reserves.
Who Needs This

People under high stress — cortisol response burns through B5 and B6

The 8 B Vitamins and Their Roles
B1 (Thiamine): carbohydrate metabolism, nerve function
B2 (Riboflavin): energy production, skin cell renewal
B3 (Niacin): DNA repair, energy metabolism
B5 (Pantothenic Acid): stress hormone production, CoA synthesis
B6 (Pyridoxine): serotonin synthesis, immune function
B7 (Biotin): fatty acid synthesis, glucose metabolism, hair/nail health
B9 (Folate): DNA synthesis, cell division — critical for pregnancy

721f50e7-46e7-4c55-9cff-5df0c3bfad19.text: TLDR: Nutrilite Vitamin E contains LECITHIN — the same phospholipid that makes up cell membranes. Vitamin E is fat-soluble — it protects cell membranes from oxidative damage. But standard Vitamin E can only work on the outside of cell membranes. This matters most for cardiovascular health. LDL cholesterol is only dangerous when oxidized. Vitamin E inside arterial cells prevents the LDL oxidation that triggers plaque formation. It also helps clear existing oils and fats from blood vessel walls.

Drop a small amount of Vitamin E oil into a glass of water — it floats and doesn't mix. Now drop lecithin into the same glass — it emulsifies and blends the oil into the water. That's what lecithin does in the bloodstream: it helps fat-soluble Vitamin E move through the water-based blood and enter cells.
